description: Search the MISIM.AI public library (2,797 documents: circulars, tax rulings, execution instructions, procedures, tax treaties, guides, position papers, etc.). Accepts Hebrew and English queries (≥3 chars); automatically normalizes Hebrew prefixes (ו, ה, ב, ל, מ, ש, כ). Guide-first routing: queries about form 1301 (דוח שנתי, יחיד, etc.) prioritize guides. Returns title, kind, issuing body, snippet (≤300 chars), publication date, source URL and relevance rank. For full text, call misim_get_document with the returned id. Provenance: MISIM.AI library (lc_library_public). חיפוש בספריית MISIM
